    Checkpoint a database - sqlite.org

    In brief, sqlite3_wal_checkpoint (D,X) causes the content in the write-ahead log for database X on database connection D to be transferred into the database file and for the write-ahead log to be reset. See the checkpointing documentation for addition information.

    SQLite WAL Internals — Frame Format, wal-index, Checkpoints, and ...

    SQLite Write-Ahead Logging WAL is the protocol that makes a SQLite database with multiple concurrent readers and a single writer behave like a real concurrent database. Set PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL once and reads stop blocking writes; writes stop blocking reads.
